svg.text: XYZZ Orders Platform: target architecture (production, us-east-1)
Users → Route 53 → AWS WAF → ALB → ECS Fargate (3 AZs) → RDS Proxy → RDS PostgreSQL Multi-AZ; async work stays serverless
AWS Cloud: region us-east-1 (one account per environment)
HTTPS 443 (TLS 1.3/1.2) · HTTP→301 · least outstanding requests · weighted target groups (migration: Lambda ↔ ECS)
connection pooling + multiplexing · TLS required · IAM/secret auth
Event-driven and scheduled work: stays serverless
Spiky, asynchronous, short-lived work: scales to zero, retries + DLQ built in, never slows the API.
Workers and jobs reach PostgreSQL only through RDS Proxy (reserved concurrency caps DB pressure).
ECS Fargate service · Graviton · 3–30 tasks · auto scaling (CPU + requests) · circuit-breaker rollback
Legacy Lambda (migration only) and async Lambdas also run in these subnets; they reach the DB only via RDS Proxy
